_note: Proven-retention manifest for the final language migration pass. Every Rust-owned-but-Python file must resolve to a class or file entry here (or MIGRATED status); the ownership validator enforces this. Reasons cite measurements and constitutional clauses, never convenience.

classes.CORE: Event bus / registries / manifests are stdlib-only foundation glue with measured microsecond overhead (dispatch ~0.3us, snapshot ~0.024ms). Porting the bus would rewire every module at once (big-bang, constitution §11). Retained; numeric authorities migrate per-feature.
classes.MARKET_DATA: Repository/SQL/database layers are SQLite IO orchestration, not numeric compute; the aggregation kernel migrated. A full storage port is product-scale with zero measured need. Retained.
classes.DATA_PROCESSING: Download engine is IO/threading orchestration (worker threads, locks, auth flows) around the provider boundary; numeric detectors migrated. Retained as orchestration glue.
classes.RISK: RiskEngine is fail-closed orchestration over string-keyed audit reasons, kill-switch persistence and session rules; measured ~0.017ms/request with no bottleneck. A port would split safety-critical reason strings across FFI with high regression risk and no measured benefit. Retained; numeric policy kernels are validator-approved future slices.
classes.EXECUTION: Session/planner/broker-venue orchestration is event-driven glue with persistence (checkpoints, journals) and Qt-thread coupling. The lifecycle table authority migrated. A full port is product-scale. Retained.
classes.BACKTEST: Runner/optimizer/worker are research orchestration over Python strategies (which must stay Python); metrics kernels migrated. Retained.
classes.PRESENTATION_MODEL: ChartModel/viewport math is Qt-paint-coupled presentation state; extracting it without the Qt shell is a UI rewrite in disguise. Retained pending the egui shell; no new presentation math in Python.
classes.NATIVE_UI: The Qt application shell (watchlist, chart widget, LIVE workspace, labs) is a working product-scale UI. A full egui rewrite in one pass would destroy working behavior (mission §3/§12, constitution §4/§11 gradual). Retained; the Rust+egui target is established in rust/vayren-shell with the broker panel as the first native surface; NEW surfaces must be Rust+egui.
classes.APP_UI: Composition root + Qt shell: same proof as NATIVE_UI. Retained; bootstrap wiring stays Python (composition is not numeric core).
classes.BOUNDARY_LOADER: Event loader bridges are bus-coupling glue by design. Retained.
classes.AI_ADJACENT: Adaptive/regime/ML interfaces are advisory AI-adjacent logic; AI-adjacent stays Python per constitution §2. Retained.
classes.DATA_UI: Download console is Qt UI: same proof as NATIVE_UI. Retained.
classes.RESEARCH_UI: Research panels are Python-owned research UI. Retained.
